interpretation.units: All durations in milliseconds except fractions, percentages, ratios and counts.
interpretation.ordinary: Only ordinary complete-FFN latency is used for speedup; same report has an interleaved GPU-only control.
interpretation.diagnostic: HIP events and additional host probes can perturb execution; separate ten-sample jobs are not an additive decomposition of ordinary latency.
interpretation.stage_intervals: NPU waits include scheduling/DMA/context/execution effects; BO I/O/wrapper is enclosing host stage less dispatch/wait, not physical memory bandwidth.
interpretation.aggregation: Sums and fractions are calculated per invocation then summarized. Independent stage medians are not additive.
interpretation.power: All 48 jobs have matching default-mode before/after snapshots; snapshots do not establish sustained clocks.
interpretation.causality: Changed H2D/GPU event overlap and longer GPU stage spans are associations. Shared-memory contention, power/clocks, scheduling and caches are not isolated.
interpretation.selection: Best is the lowest sampled median; no global-optimum or whole-model speedup claim.

findings.label: measured
findings.text: Best sampled fused P896 ordinary median19.9475ms vs matched GPU22.2718ms (1.1165x,30/30 paired wins); best separate P51220.5375ms vs22.3803ms (1.0897x,29/30 wins). These come from separate jobs.

findings.label: measured
findings.text: At fixedP512, ordinary fusion loses1.0522ms despite reducing NPUhost median3.8511ms. Mean decompositions locate the increased whole-FFN span in output staging/final wait, not CPU layouts.

findings.label: measured
findings.text: P512 diagnostic fused GPUbranch and down event medians are0.5949ms and0.3318ms longer; H2D event overlaps down10/10 fused vs2/10 separate samples. This is association, not causality.

findings.label: measured
findings.text: The separate P512 diagnostic total-latency ordering reverses ordinary ordering. Its unfused host layouts are slower, so diagnostic results cannot reconstruct ordinary timing.

findings.label: measured
findings.text: At fusedP896 all10 diagnostic samples finish the GPUbranch after the H2Dcopy; at fusedP1536 all10 finish H2Dcopy last. This supports an observed balancing region, not an exact NPU/GPU clock-aligned timeline.

findings.label: proposed
findings.text: A controlled deferred-H2D ablation could test copy placement effects; power/clocks, caches, physical DRAM bandwidth and shared-host scheduling are not isolated by this sweep.
